scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.jsx ReelVertical ../out/.raw-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --concurrency=4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i ../out/.raw-vertical.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart ../out/pitaka-reel-vertical.mp4 && rm ../out/.raw-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:horizontal: remotion render src/index.jsx ReelHorizontal ../out/.raw-horizontal.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --concurrency=4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i ../out/.raw-horizontal.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart ../out/pitaka-reel-horizontal.mp4 && rm ../out/.raw-horizontal.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:horizontal
